steps.says: A figure is written off once into lines: its caption (title, axes, legend) and its numbers. No other request is sent its image.
The document is cut into numbered lines and into pieces; the code does it, no request.
steps.bound: a piece is at most {piece_lines} lines, a table's head shown with each of its pieces; the title page is the first {title_page_lines} lines of the first page; a request shows the last {headings} headings up to its place

steps.says: The sentence the pieces are ordered and searched with for a field, written as this document would print a value of it.
What the document settles for all its values, and its own base and target years: the title page, then the best pieces of the search and after them the rest of the document, until a request finds it.
Which lines of a piece speak of another work, and which line shows that the rest are this publication's own.
A field the document has once is asked over the title page and the best pieces of the search; every find is kept.
steps.bound: {search_pieces} pieces, {listed_field_factor} times as many for a field with a list; {search_per_request} a request

steps.each: other field, in each piece, the best pieces first
steps.says: The values of a field in one piece: an address and its words, and the entry where the field has a list. An answer that does not fit its room is asked again in halves of the piece.
Each coordinate of each value is asked on its own, in the order of the spec's groups.

At the value's own place: its line with the head of its table or the sentences beside it, the headings up to it, the title page and what the document settles. The answer is an address and words, or 0.

A sentence of how the document would print the answer, written once per field, coordinate and wording of the value; the search goes with it. Off, or where it writes none, the search goes with the field's own sentence.
The pieces right before and after the value's. What only the value's own place can say is not searched.
The pieces the search finds best for that sentence, ordered once by the reranker. The model may fetch pieces itself, which do not count; no piece is shown twice.
steps.bound: {search_pieces} pieces: the shares of tables, figures and text first ({search_tables}, {search_figures} and {search_text}, scaled to the pieces), then the best of the rest; {search_per_request} a request

steps.when: a find stands in another passage
steps.says: Does the place the find stands in speak about this value?
A year nothing found is asked last with the document's base and target years.
The entry of a list that a wording means, asked once per wording; the answer is a number of the list.
steps.bound: a list of up to {list_meanings} entries shows what each means; a longer one shows names only, and one whose entries name groups is asked group first

steps.says: The entry of the document's list of scenarios or works that a name means, a new entry where it is not on the list yet. Words for several of them become one row per member where the field takes groups.
The request is asked again as a request of its own, with the answer that did not hold and why.

steps.when: a reply is out of its form
steps.says: A reply that is no JSON object of the request's form is asked again with the cause, and so is a request the server refuses. A failure of the server is asked again until the run halts.
steps.bound: {replies} such replies at most, then the request stays unanswered

steps.each: question the folded rows leave open
steps.says: What the checked rows of a document leave open is computed: a share without its absolute number, parts without their sum. The model writes the code and the sandbox runs it.
